name: Ataur Rahman Khan
contribution: Ataur Rahman Khan was a lawyer and opposition politician who served as chief minister of East Pakistan and later held national office in Bangladesh.
context: His politics challenged central domination and contributed to the growth of a more assertive provincial public voice in East Pakistan.
impact: He represents the constitutional and electoral strand of Bengali autonomy politics.
